verses.text: After dis, Nahash king of Ammon die, and im pikin rule for im place.

David talk say, “I go show kindness to Hanun, Nahash pikin, because im papa show kindness to me.” So David send messengers to comfort am about im papa. David servants come to Hanun for Ammon land to comfort am.
But di princes of Ammon talk to Hanun say, “You think say David dey honor your papa, say e send people come comfort you? Im servants no come to you to search, to overthrow and to spy di land?”
So Hanun take David servants, shave dem, cut dem clothes for di middle reach dem buttocks, and send dem go.
Some go tell David how dem treat di men. E send people go meet dem, because di men dey very ashamed. Di king talk say, “Stay for Jericho until your beards grow, den return.”

As Ammon pikin dem see say dem don make dem smell bad before David, Hanun and di Ammonites send 1,000 talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen from Mesopotamia, from Aram Maacah and from Zobah.
So dem hire 32,000 chariots and di king of Maacah with im people, wey come camp before Medeba. Ammon pikin dem gather from dem cities and come to battle.
As David hear am, e send Joab and all di army of di brave men.
Ammon pikin dem come out and arrange di battle for di gate of di city, and di kings wey come dey by demselves for di field.
As Joab see say dem don set di battle against am for front and for back, e choose some of di best men of Israel and arrange dem against di Syrians.
Di rest of di people e put under Abishai im brother, and dem arrange dem against Ammon pikin dem.
E talk say, “If di Syrians strong pass me, den you go help me, but if Ammon pikin dem strong pass you, den I go help you.
Make una be strong, make we dey strong for our people and for di cities of our God. Make di Lord do wetin good for im eyes.”
So Joab and di people wey dey with am come near before di Syrians for battle, and dem run before am.
As Ammon pikin dem see say di Syrians don run, dem run too before Abishai im brother and enter di city. Den Joab come Jerusalem.
As di Syrians see say Israel don defeat dem, dem send messengers and bring out di Syrians wey dey di other side of di River, with Shophach, captain of Hadadezer army, for front of dem.
Dem tell David, and e gather all Israel together, cross Jordan, come against dem and arrange battle against dem. As David arrange battle against di Syrians, dem fight am.
Di Syrians run before Israel, and David kill 7,000 charioteers and 40,000 foot soldiers of di Syrians, and e kill Shophach, captain of di army.
As Hadadezer servants see say Israel don defeat dem, dem make peace with David and serve am. Di Syrians no gree help Ammon pikin dem again.

For di time of di return of di year, di time wey kings dey go out, Joab lead di army out and waste di country of Ammon pikin dem, and e come surround Rabbah. But David stay for Jerusalem. Joab strike Rabbah and destroy am.
David take di crown of dem king from im head, and e find say e weigh one talent of gold, and precious stones dey inside am. Dem put am on David head. E bring out plenty plenty things from di city.
E bring out di people wey dey inside am and cut dem with saws, with iron picks and with axes. David do so to all di cities of Ammon pikin dem. David and all di people return go Jerusalem.
After dis, war dey for Gezer with di Philistines. Den Sibbekai di Hushathite kill Sippai, one of di giants descendants, and dem defeat dem.
War dey again with di Philistines, and Elhanan, Jair pikin, kill Lahmi, Goliath di Gittite brother, wey im spear staff be like weaver beam.
War dey again for Gath, wia one very tall man dey, wey im fingers and toes na 24, six for each hand and six for each foot. E too na di giant pikin.
As e challenge Israel, Jonathan, Shimea pikin, David brother, kill am.
Dem born dis ones to di giant for Gath, and dem fall by David hand and by di hand of im servants.
Satan stand up against Israel and push David to count Israel.
David talk to Joab and di princes of di people say, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba reach Dan, and bring word come meet me, so that I go know how dem be.”
Joab talk say, “Make di Lord make im people 100 times as plenty as dem be. But my oga di king, dem no be all my oga servants? Why my oga want dis thing? Why e go make Israel guilty?”
Still, di king word win Joab. So Joab leave, waka all over Israel and come Jerusalem.
Joab give David di total of di people wey dem count. All Israel na 1,100,000 men wey draw sword, and Judah na 470,000 men wey draw sword.
But e no count Levi and Benjamin among dem, because di king word dey disgusting to Joab.
God no happy with dis thing, so e strike Israel.
David talk to God say, “I don sin well well because I do dis thing. But now, I beg, take away di sin of your servant, because I don do very foolish thing.”
Di Lord talk to Gad, David seer, say,
“Go talk to David say, ‘Dis na wetin di Lord talk: “I dey give you three things. Choose one of dem, so that I go do am to you.”’”
So Gad come to David and talk to am say, “Dis na wetin di Lord talk: ‘Choose for yourself,

either three years of hunger, or three months to dey destroyed before your enemies as dem sword catch you, or three days of di Lord sword, even plague for di land, with di angel of di Lord dey destroy all di borders of Israel.’ Now decide wetin answer I go carry go give di one wey send me.”
David talk to Gad say, “I dey big trouble. Make I fall into di hand of di Lord, because im mercy plenty well well. No make me fall into man hand.”
So di Lord send plague on Israel, and 70,000 men of Israel fall.

God send angel go Jerusalem to destroy am, but as e wan destroy am, di Lord look and change im mind about di evil, and talk to di angel wey dey destroy say, “E don do. Now stop your hand.” Di angel of di Lord dey stand by Ornan di Jebusite threshing floor.

David lift up im eyes and see di angel of di Lord dey stand between di earth and di sky, with drawn sword for im hand wey e stretch over Jerusalem. Den David and di elders, wey wear sackcloth, fall with dem face down.

David talk to God say, “No be me command say make dem count di people? Na me sin and do very wicked thing, but dis sheep, wetin dem do? I beg, di Lord my God, make your hand dey against me and against my papa house, but no make e dey against your people to plague dem.”
Den di angel of di Lord command Gad to talk to David say make David go up and build altar to di Lord for Ornan di Jebusite threshing floor.
David go up as Gad talk, wey e talk for di name of di Lord.
Ornan turn back and see di angel, and im four sons wey dey with am hide. Ornan dey thresh wheat.
As David come to Ornan, Ornan look and see David, and e go out of di threshing floor and bow to David with im face to di ground.
Den David talk to Ornan say, “Give me di place of dis threshing floor, so that I go build altar to di Lord inside am. Give am to me for di full price, so that di plague go stop from di people.”

Ornan talk to David say, “Take am for yourself, and make my oga di king do wetin good for im eyes. Look, I give di oxen for burnt sacrifice, di threshing tools for wood and di wheat for grain sacrifice. I give all am.”
King David talk to Ornan say, “No, but I go buy am for di full price, because I no go take wetin be your own for di Lord, or offer burnt sacrifice wey no cost me anything.”
So David give Ornan 600 shekels of gold by weight for di place.
David build altar to di Lord there, offer burnt sacrifice and peace sacrifice, and call on di Lord. E answer am from heaven with fire on di altar of burnt sacrifice.
Di Lord command di angel, and e put im sword back inside im sheath.
For dat time, as David see say di Lord don answer am for Ornan di Jebusite threshing floor, e make sacrifice there.
Because di tabernacle of di Lord, wey Moses make for di wilderness, and di altar of burnt sacrifice, dey di high place for Gibeon for dat time.
But David no fit go before am to ask God, because e fear di sword of di angel of di Lord.
David talk say, “Dis na di house of di Lord God, and dis na di altar of burnt sacrifice for Israel.”
David command make dem gather di foreigners wey dey Israel land, and e put masons to cut stones to build God house.
David prepare plenty iron for di nails for di doors of di gates and for di joints, and plenty bronze wey dem no fit weigh,
and cedar trees wey nobody fit count, because di Sidonians and di people of Tyre bring plenty cedar come meet David.

David talk say, “Solomon my pikin dey young and soft, and di house wey dem go build for di Lord must be very big, famous and glorious for all countries. So I go prepare for am.” So David prepare plenty before im death.
Den e call Solomon im pikin and command am to build house for di Lord, di God of Israel.
David talk to Solomon say, “My pikin, as for me, e dey my heart to build house for di name of di Lord my God.
But di word of di Lord come to me say, ‘You don shed plenty blood and fight big wars. You no go build house for my name, because you don shed plenty blood for di earth before me.
Look, one pikin go born for you, wey go be man of rest. I go give am rest from all im enemies round, because im name go be Solomon, and I go give peace and quiet to Israel for im days.
E go build house for my name, and e go be my pikin, and I go be im papa. I go make di throne of im kingdom over Israel stand forever.’
Now, my pikin, make di Lord dey with you, and make you prosper and build di house of di Lord your God, as e talk about you.
Only make di Lord give you wisdom and understanding, and give you charge over Israel, so that you go keep di law of di Lord your God.
Den you go prosper, if you take care to do di laws and di rules wey di Lord give Moses about Israel. Be strong and brave. No fear and no shake.

Now look, for my trouble I don prepare for di Lord house 100,000 talents of gold, 1,000,000 talents of silver, and bronze and iron wey no get weight, because e plenty. I don prepare wood and stone too, and you fit add to dem.
Plenty workmen dey with you, cutters and workers of stone and wood, and all kind of skilled men for every kind of work.
Di gold, di silver, di bronze and di iron no get number. Stand up and work, and make di Lord dey with you.”
David command all di princes of Israel too to help Solomon im pikin, say,
“Di Lord your God no dey with una? E no give una rest for every side? Because e don give di people wey dey stay for di land into my hand, and di land dey under di Lord and im people.

Now set your heart and your soul to look for di Lord your God. Stand up, so, and build di sanctuary of di Lord God, to bring di ark of di covenant of di Lord and di holy vessels of God enter di house wey dem go build for di name of di Lord.”
Now David don old and full of days, and e make Solomon im pikin king over Israel.
E gather together all di princes of Israel, with di priests and di Levites.
Dem count di Levites from 30 years old and above, and dem number by head, man by man, na 38,000.
“From dis ones, 24,000 go oversee di work of di Lord house, 6,000 go be officers and judges,
4,000 go be doorkeepers, and 4,000 go praise di Lord with di instruments wey I make,” David talk, “to praise with dem.”
David divide dem into groups according to Levi pikin dem: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
From di Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
Ladan pikin dem na di chief Jehiel, Zetham and Joel, three.
Shimei pikin dem na Shelomoth, Haziel and Haran, three. Dis ones na di heads of di papa dem houses of Ladan.
Shimei pikin dem na Jahath, Zina, Jeush and Beriah. Dis four na Shimei pikin dem.
Jahath na di chief, and Zizah di second, but Jeush and Beriah no get plenty pikin, so dem count dem as one papa house.
Kohath pikin dem na Amram, Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel, four.
Amram pikin dem na Aaron and Moses. Dem separate Aaron to make di most holy things holy, e and im pikin dem forever, to burn incense before di Lord, to serve am and to bless for im name forever.
But as for Moses, di man of God, dem count im pikin dem among Levi tribe.
Moses pikin dem na Gershom and Eliezer.
Gershom pikin na Shebuel di chief.
Eliezer pikin na Rehabiah di chief. Eliezer no get other pikin, but Rehabiah pikin dem plenty well well.
Izhar pikin na Shelomith di chief.
Hebron pikin dem na Jeriah di chief, Amariah di second, Jahaziel di third and Jekameam di fourth.
Uzziel pikin dem na Micah di chief and Isshiah di second.
Merari pikin dem na Mahli and Mushi. Mahli pikin dem na Eleazar and Kish.
Eleazar die and no get sons, only daughters, and dem brothers, Kish pikin dem, marry dem.
Mushi pikin dem na Mahli, Eder and Jeremoth, three.

Dis na Levi pikin dem according to dem papa dem houses, even di heads of di papa dem houses, as dem count dem one by one by di number of names by head, wey do di work for di service of di Lord house, from 20 years old and above.
Because David talk say, “Di Lord, di God of Israel, don give im people rest, and e dey stay for Jerusalem forever.
Di Levites no go carry di tabernacle and all im vessels for im service again.”
Because by David last words dem count Levi pikin dem from 20 years old and above.
Because dem duty na to wait on Aaron pikin dem for di service of di Lord house, for di courts, for di rooms, for di cleaning of all holy things, even di work of di service of God house,
for di bread of di presence, di fine flour for grain sacrifice, di bread wey no get yeast, wetin dem bake for pan, wetin dem soak, and all kind of measure and size,
and to stand every morning to thank and praise di Lord, and for evening too,
and to offer all burnt sacrifice to di Lord on Sabbaths, on new moons and on di fixed feasts, for number according to di rule about dem, always before di Lord,
and make dem keep di duty of di Tent of Meeting, di duty of di holy place and di duty of Aaron pikin dem dem brothers, for di service of di Lord house.
Dis na di groups of Aaron pikin dem: Aaron pikin dem na Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
But Nadab and Abihu die before dem papa and no get pikin, so Eleazar and Ithamar do di priest work.
David, with Zadok from Eleazar pikin dem and Ahimelech from Ithamar pikin dem, divide dem according to dem work for dem service.

Dem find more chief men among Eleazar pikin dem pass Ithamar pikin dem, and na so dem divide dem: from Eleazar pikin dem dem get 16 heads of papa dem houses, and from Ithamar pikin dem, according to dem papa dem houses, eight.
Na so dem divide dem by lot, one group with another, because princes of di sanctuary and princes of God dey among Eleazar pikin dem and among Ithamar pikin dem.

Shemaiah, Nethanel pikin, di secretary, wey be Levite, write dem down before di king, di princes, Zadok di priest, Ahimelech, Abiathar pikin, and di heads of di papa dem houses of di priests and of di Levites. Dem take one papa house for Eleazar and one for Ithamar.
Now di first lot come out to Jehoiarib, di second to Jedaiah,
di third to Harim, di fourth to Seorim,
di fifth to Malchijah, di sixth to Mijamin,
di seventh to Hakkoz, di eighth to Abijah,
di ninth to Jeshua, di tenth to Shecaniah,
di 11th to Eliashib, di 12th to Jakim,
di 13th to Huppah, di 14th to Jeshebeab,
di 15th to Bilgah, di 16th to Immer,
di 17th to Hezir, di 18th to Happizzez,
di 19th to Pethahiah, di 20th to Jehezkel,
di 21st to Jachin, di 22nd to Gamul,
di 23rd to Delaiah, di 24th to Maaziah.
Dis na dem order for dem service, to enter di Lord house according to di rule wey Aaron dem papa give dem, as di Lord, di God of Israel, command am.
For di rest of Levi pikin dem: from Amram pikin dem, Shubael, from Shubael pikin dem, Jehdeiah.
About Rehabiah: from Rehabiah pikin dem, di chief na Isshiah.
From di Izharites, Shelomoth, from Shelomoth pikin dem, Jahath.
Hebron pikin dem na Jeriah, Amariah di second, Jahaziel di third and Jekameam di fourth.
Uzziel pikin na Micah, and from Micah pikin dem, Shamir.
Micah brother na Isshiah, and from Isshiah pikin dem, Zechariah.
Merari pikin dem na Mahli and Mushi, and Jaaziah pikin na Beno.
Merari pikin dem by Jaaziah na Beno, Shoham, Zaccur and Ibri.
From Mahli: Eleazar, wey no get sons.
From Kish: Kish pikin na Jerahmeel.
Mushi pikin dem na Mahli, Eder and Jerimoth. Dis na di Levites pikin dem according to dem papa dem houses.

Dis ones draw lots too like dem brothers Aaron pikin dem before David di king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and di heads of di papa dem houses of di priests and of di Levites, di main papa dem houses just like dem small brothers.

Again David and di captains of di army separate some of Asaph, Heman and Jeduthun pikin dem for di service, to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments and with cymbals. Dis na di number of di men wey do di work according to dem service:
from Asaph pikin dem: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah and Asharelah, Asaph pikin dem under Asaph hand, wey dey prophesy as di king order.
From Jeduthun: Jeduthun pikin dem na Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, Mattithiah and Shimei, six, under dem papa Jeduthun hand, wey dey prophesy with harp to give thanks and to praise di Lord.
From Heman: Heman pikin dem na Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir and Mahazioth.
All dis ones na Heman pikin dem, di king seer for God words, to lift up di horn. God give Heman 14 sons and three daughters.
All dis ones dey under dem papa hands for song for di Lord house, with cymbals, stringed instruments and harps, for di service of God house. Asaph, Jeduthun and Heman dey under di king order.
Dem number, with dem brothers wey dem teach to sing to di Lord, even all wey get skill, na 288.
Dem draw lots for dem duties, all di same, di small and di big, di teacher and di student.
Now di first lot for Asaph come out to Joseph. Di second to Gedaliah, e and im brothers and pikin dem na 12.
Di third to Zaccur, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di fourth to Izri, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di fifth to Nethaniah, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di sixth to Bukkiah, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di seventh to Jesharelah, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di eighth to Jeshaiah, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di ninth to Mattaniah, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di tenth to Shimei, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di 11th to Azarel, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di 12th to Hashabiah, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di 13th to Shubael, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di 14th to Mattithiah, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di 15th to Jerimoth, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di 16th to Hananiah, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di 17th to Joshbekashah, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di 18th to Hanani, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di 19th to Mallothi, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di 20th to Eliathah, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di 21st to Hothir, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di 22nd to Giddalti, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di 23rd to Mahazioth, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
Di 24th to Romamti Ezer, e, im pikin dem and im brothers, 12.
For di groups of di doorkeepers: from di Korahites, Meshelemiah, Kore pikin, from Asaph pikin dem.
Meshelemiah get pikin dem: Zechariah di firstborn, Jediael di second, Zebadiah di third, Jathniel di fourth,
Elam di fifth, Jehohanan di sixth and Eliehoenai di seventh.
Obed Edom get pikin dem: Shemaiah di firstborn, Jehozabad di second, Joah di third, Sacar di fourth, Nethanel di fifth,
Ammiel di sixth, Issachar di seventh and Peullethai di eighth, because God bless am.
Dem born pikin dem for im pikin Shemaiah, wey rule over dem papa house, because dem be brave and mighty men.
Shemaiah pikin dem na Othni, Rephael, Obed and Elzabad, wey im brothers na brave men, Elihu and Semachiah.
All dis ones na Obed Edom pikin dem. Dem and dem pikin dem and dem brothers, men wey get strength for di service, na 62 from Obed Edom.
Meshelemiah get pikin dem and brothers, brave men, 18.
Hosah, from Merari pikin dem, get pikin dem too: Shimri di chief, because even though e no be di firstborn, im papa make am chief,
Hilkiah di second, Tebaliah di third and Zechariah di fourth. All Hosah pikin dem and brothers na 13.
From dis ones na di groups of di doorkeepers, even of di chief men, wey get duties like dem brothers, to serve for di Lord house.
Dem draw lots, di small and di big, according to dem papa dem houses, for every gate.
Di lot for east fall to Shelemiah. Den dem draw lots for Zechariah im pikin, wise counselor, and im lot come out for north.
To Obed Edom for south, and to im pikin dem di storehouse.
To Shuppim and Hosah for west, by di gate of Shallecheth, by di road wey dey go up, watch against watch.
For east na six Levites, for north four every day, for south four every day, and for di storehouse two and two.
For di Parbar for west, four for di road and two for di Parbar.
Dis na di groups of di doorkeepers, from Korahites pikin dem and from Merari pikin dem.
From di Levites, Ahijah dey over di treasures of God house and over di treasures of di things wey dem give to God.
Ladan pikin dem, di Gershonites wey belong to Ladan, di heads of di papa dem houses wey belong to Ladan di Gershonite: Jehieli.
Jehieli pikin dem na Zetham and Joel im brother, over di treasures of di Lord house.
From di Amramites, from di Izharites, from di Hebronites, from di Uzzielites:
Shebuel, Gershom pikin, Moses pikin, na ruler over di treasures.
Im brothers from Eliezer: Rehabiah im pikin, Jeshaiah im pikin, Joram im pikin, Zichri im pikin and Shelomoth im pikin.

Dis Shelomoth and im brothers dey over all di treasures of di things wey dem give to God, wey David di king, di heads of di papa dem houses, di captains over thousands and hundreds and di captains of di army give to God.
From di things wey dem win for battles na im dem give to repair di Lord house.
All wey Samuel di seer, Saul, Kish pikin, Abner, Ner pikin, and Joab, Zeruiah pikin, give to God, anything wey anybody give to God, e dey under Shelomoth and im brothers hand.
From di Izharites, Chenaniah and im pikin dem dey for di outside work over Israel, as officers and judges.
From di Hebronites, Hashabiah and im brothers, brave men, 1,700, dey over Israel for di other side of Jordan for west, for all di business of di Lord and for di service of di king.

From di Hebronites, Jerijah na di chief of di Hebronites, according to dem generations by papa dem houses. For di 40th year of David rule dem look for dem, and dem find brave and mighty men among dem for Jazer of Gilead.

Im brothers, brave men, na 2,700, heads of papa dem houses, wey King David make overseers over di Reubenites, di Gadites and half of Manasseh tribe, for every matter about God and for di king affairs.

Now Israel pikin dem according to dem number, di heads of papa dem houses and di captains of thousands and of hundreds, and dem officers wey serve di king for any matter of di groups wey dey come in and go out month by month through all di months of di year, every group na 24,000.
Over di first group for di first month na Jashobeam, Zabdiel pikin, and 24,000 dey im group.
E be from Perez pikin dem, chief of all di captains of di army for di first month.
Over di group of di second month na Dodai di Ahohite, and Mikloth na ruler of im group, and 24,000 dey im group.
Di third captain of di army for di third month na Benaiah, Jehoiada di priest pikin, chief, and 24,000 dey im group.
Dis na di Benaiah wey be brave man among di 30 and over di 30, and Ammizabad im pikin dey im group.
Di fourth captain for di fourth month na Asahel, Joab brother, and Zebadiah im pikin after am, and 24,000 dey im group.
Di fifth captain for di fifth month na Shamhuth di Izrahite, and 24,000 dey im group.
Di sixth captain for di sixth month na Ira, Ikkesh pikin, di Tekoite, and 24,000 dey im group.
Di seventh captain for di seventh month na Helez di Pelonite, from Ephraim pikin dem, and 24,000 dey im group.
Di eighth captain for di eighth month na Sibbecai di Hushathite, from di Zerahites, and 24,000 dey im group.
Di ninth captain for di ninth month na Abiezer di Anathothite, from di Benjamites, and 24,000 dey im group.
Di tenth captain for di tenth month na Maharai di Netophathite, from di Zerahites, and 24,000 dey im group.
Di 11th captain for di 11th month na Benaiah di Pirathonite, from Ephraim pikin dem, and 24,000 dey im group.
Di 12th captain for di 12th month na Heldai di Netophathite, from Othniel, and 24,000 dey im group.
Again, over di tribes of Israel: from di Reubenites na Eliezer, Zichri pikin, di ruler, from di Simeonites, Shephatiah, Maacah pikin,
from di Levites, Hashabiah, Kemuel pikin, from di Aaronites, Zadok,
from Judah, Elihu, one of David brothers, from Issachar, Omri, Michael pikin,
from Zebulun, Ishmaiah, Obadiah pikin, from Naphtali, Jerimoth, Azriel pikin,
from Ephraim pikin dem, Hoshea, Azaziah pikin, from half of Manasseh tribe, Joel, Pedaiah pikin,
from half of Manasseh tribe for Gilead, Iddo, Zechariah pikin, from Benjamin, Jaasiel, Abner pikin,
from Dan, Azarel, Jeroham pikin. Dis na di captains of di tribes of Israel.
But David no count dem wey dey 20 years old and below, because di Lord don talk say e go make Israel plenty like di stars of di sky.
Joab, Zeruiah pikin, begin to count, but e no finish, and anger come on Israel because of dis, and dem no put di number for di record of King David chronicles.
Over di king treasures na Azmaveth, Adiel pikin, and over di storehouses for di field, for di cities, for di villages and for di towers na Jonathan, Uzziah pikin,
over dem wey do di work of di field to plant di ground na Ezri, Chelub pikin,
over di vineyards na Shimei di Ramathite, and over di increase of di vineyards for di wine cellars na Zabdi di Shiphmite,
over di olive trees and di sycamore trees wey dey di low land na Baal Hanan di Gederite, and over di oil cellars na Joash,
over di herds wey dey feed for Sharon na Shitrai di Sharonite, and over di herds wey dey di valleys na Shaphat, Adlai pikin,
over di camels na Obil di Ishmaelite, over di donkeys na Jehdeiah di Meronothite, and over di flocks na Jaziz di Hagrite.
All dis ones na rulers of di property wey belong to King David.
Jonathan, David uncle, na counselor too, man wey get understanding, and secretary. Jehiel, Hachmoni pikin, dey with di king pikin dem.
Ahithophel na di king counselor, and Hushai di Archite na di king friend.
After Ahithophel na Jehoiada, Benaiah pikin, and Abiathar, and di captain of di king army na Joab.
